reviews.text:
Owner ensured he was on site when insurance adjusters arrives. He pointed out items they didn’t initially catch (nor did I) such as damage to dormer window, outdoor light fixture, and even the trampoline, window screens, all which the insurance company obliged to replace.

Very upfront, professional, and thorough. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael Constantine

reviews.text:
Bledar (boss @ Twin Eagle) is not only THE BEST TYERE IS in his roofing construction work but also:

A) an encyclopedia of information on ANYTHING you need for your house construction, maintenance, troubleshooting, or ANY HOME IMPROVEMENT job you may need. Though he's pretty close to the JACK OF ALL TRADE-type MR. FIX IT, he'll be honest with you and recommend other people who can do any job ge can't do in a competent and inexpensive/least expensive manner as well as give you free consultation on various options.

B) customer service 2nd to none! I'm proud to call him a family friend owing to the respectful way he deals with me and my whole family,  God bless his heart.
reviews.author: Mohammad Omary

reviews.text: I hired Twin Eagle Roofing to redo the roof on my house in North Dallas, and was very pleased with the experience and the result. The owner was polite, professional, and upfront. He took the time to explain the different available options, and appropriately addressed my concerns. The accompanying crew was quick, clean, and most importantly respectful towards my property. In addition, they also did a superb job with the gutters, various trim work, as well as staining my fence. The overall results are outstanding and I couldn't be happier! This company takes pride in their meticulous work and gets it right the first time. I've recommended Twin Eagle Roofing to my neighbors, coworkers, family, and friends - and they all share similar experiences. Thank you!
reviews.author: Elio Male

reviews.text: Excellent service and very fast! They were able to help me with my roof and change it in a day! They made my first claim EVER so painless and easy! Definitely recommend!
reviews.author: Annbel Mendoza

reviews.text: They are very professional and get the job done right and on time. I have used them now on 2 of my houses. I will use them again for my third when needed.

data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic with a consistent positive rating over many years. The low volume (13 reviews each on Google and Yelp) for a 9-year-old company is a minor concern, but the content is specific and varied. The single negative review cites unprofessional behavior but lacks detail. No warranty or guarantee patterns are evident.
fake_signals: Some reviews are very brief and generic (e.g., 'Very good service')
One 5-star review is cut off mid-sentence
authentic_signals: Specific details about insurance claims and damage items
Mentions of owner's name (Bledar) and on-site presence
Varied project types (roof, gutters, trim, fence)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent across Google and Yelp. BBB has no rating or complaints, which is neutral.
